exhaustion: No selection among these ordered templates = bounded template gap, not proof of impossibility in scientific domain. Retain slot with reason; running a partial revised list requires new review.
exact: Schema-aware hash from accepted canonical_config over entire common. All old public H20 configs plus same-list rows excluded. New fixtures use only X01/X08 and perform no new config mutations.
semantic: Compare active public acquisition/repair opportunity signatures, reachable component limitations and external challenge. Ignore labels, surplus budget/window, raw inactive reservations, unused recipe suffixes and E0-only differences. Distinct reachable requested stage, physical limitation or genuinely different action/record time required. Compare to every resolvable public H20 config and earlier rows. Reject full related group on collision.
arithmetic: Each acquisition reserves work+exit, sample=start+work, arrival=sample+publish, expiry=sample+ttl. For normal authorized chain reserve prep+commit+exit + verify+exit, submit after legal evidence or direct, schedule approval, first fitting FIX interval, commit at start+prep+commit_work, verify no earlier than exit and receipt, then publish. W_min=max(arrival+1,reserved_until) on integer clock. Static prerequisites only. Failure labels never establish actual reached stage.
